title: Battle of the Göhrde
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of the Göhrde", at revision 1377018421, opens: "The Battle of the Göhrde took place during the War of the Sixth Coalition on 16 September 1813 between French and Coalition troops at Göhrde, Germany. The French troops were defeated and withdrew to Hamburg." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q541647, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1813 battle during the War of the Sixth Coalition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
